  - [schema-breach] <root>: ['message_role_definition/2'] appear in BOTH `requires` and `inputs`. `requires` means another clause must define it; `inputs` means it is supplied with the case being judged. A predicate cannot be both, and without the distinction 'a name nothing defines' cannot be told from 'a name supplied at query time'
  - [schema-breach] <root>: `message_role_definition/2` is borrowed but has no gloss. Add a `concepts` entry saying what this module needs it to MEAN — not what defines it, which stays in `requires`/`inputs`. Without it a seat is shown a bare predicate name, and nothing can match this to the clause that defines it   (× 2 — the same finding at 2 sites)

Fix every one of them. Return the corrected module, complete.
